description: OSM Grid Definition is Open Energy Transition's collection of Overpass queries behind the MapYourGrid Map It page. It defines ways to retrieve electric transmission features from OpenStreetMap at national and smaller administrative scales. A modeller selects a query type and area; the query returns mapped grid objects that can be checked and transformed into a network inventory. Geography follows the chosen boundary, while temporal coverage is the OpenStreetMap state at query time. Files are Overpass QL text and version markers in a free MIT-licensed GitHub repository. The README explains the required admin-level 2 and 4 query files and how they map to website buttons. A limitation is that these files are query definitions, not a cleaned electrical network; mapped lines may be incomplete and electrical parameters still need checking. They can prepare source topology for power-flow or outage simulations. The existing data-gridkit-power-grid-extracts record is an example of a processed OSM-derived grid, while this repository provides the retrieval definitions. No Overpass query was executed in this review.
